{{Quote|Put your hands up!|A police droid|<ref name="PoP">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
The '''GU-series Guardian police droid''', also stylized as '''GU-series "Guardian"''' or simply '''Guardian police droid''', was a model of [[Police droid/Legends|police droid]] utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF) to assist with [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Color/Legends|blue-gray]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]] and were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape, with a head that formed into a cylindrical [[Armor/Legends|helmet]]. They patrolled [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] and responded to calls either on [[Limb/Legends|foot]] or in [[RapidResponse police speeder/Legends|RapidResponse police speeders]] and [[Coruscant police speeder/Legends|Coruscant police speeders]]. Most often, the police droids were the first responders to situations. They created perimeters, questioned witnesses, and collected evidence before handing the cases over to organic [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] and [[Detective/Legends|investigators]]. Police droids were armed with [[SS-410 Police Special blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and [[Baton/Legends|batons]]. The police droids were involved in several cases, including the investigation of the [[Kidnapping of the Papanoida daughters/Legends|kidnapping]] of [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe]] and [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway]], the daughters of [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]. They also assisted [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] during the [[Death/Legends|homicide]] investigation of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]]. They collected evidence, secured the crime scene, and assisted in arresting the [[Lolo Purs/Legends|murderer]]. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the police droids began to be phased out, though they saw continued general use.

==Description==
{{Quote|Drop your weapons and come with us quietly!|A police droid|<ref name="PoP" />}}
The GU-series "Guardian" police [[Droid/Legends|droids]]<ref name="blog">{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars-10|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'' #10|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}}</ref> were used by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF) on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to assist organic [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] in [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|maintaining order]] on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] world over the generations leading up to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Senate Murders Episode commentary">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep215|text="Senate Murders" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Specifically, the police droids were deployed on the upper levels of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], while the rougher [[Coruscant Underworld Police|underworld police officers]] patrolled the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]].<ref name="CSFunderpolice">{{SWE|groups|coruscant-underworld-police|Coruscant underworld police}}</ref> While given combat programming, their primary function was to prevent people from being harmed.<ref name="episguide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:CSFpolicedroids.png|thumb|left|250px|Police droids with weapons drawn]]
The police droids were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape, with long, dexterous [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and five-fingered hands, legs, a central torso, and a head. The top of the head were capped by a tall, cylindrical [[Armor/Legends|shako-like helmet]] that housed sensors and a comm suite.<ref name="EV" /> The nondescript face of the droid sported two glowing, [[Color/Legends|gold]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] and a tiny mouth, which allowed the droids to intake fluids for testing.<ref name="PoP" /> The units were painted in a blue-gray color scheme and wore the CSF symbol painted on their helmet, as well as the upper left section of the breastplate. They were programmed as [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] and could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Senate Murders Episode commentary" /> When shut down, the droids could be activated remotely through devices such as a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="Senate Murders" /> The droids could also intake fluids through their [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]].<ref name="PoP" />

Police droids were equipped with [[SS-410 Police Special blaster pistol/Legends|SS-410 Police Special blaster pistols]] and a [[Baton/Legends|simple truncheon]] to defend themselves and others. They could also use [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]], [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]], [[Riot shield/Legends|riot shields]], and [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] depending on their assignment.<ref name="EV" /> Their duties included setting up a perimeter, collecting evidence, preliminary interrogations, and holding and arresting suspects. When on patrol, the police droids either traveled on foot or used [[RapidResponse police speeder/Legends|RapidResponse police speeders]]<ref name="Senate Murders" /> and [[Coruscant police speeder/Legends|Coruscant police speeders]].<ref name="PoP" />

==History==
[[File:Policedroids.png|thumb|right|220px|Police droids apprehend Ione Marcy.]]
{{Quote|That is a stolen vehicle. Put your hands in the air!|A police droid, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="PoP" />}}
Manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] on contract for the Galactic Republic, the Coruscant Security Force employed thousands of the GU-series droids for [[Time/Legends|generations]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|eruption]] of the Clone Wars. The droids were used to patrol Coruscant's upper levels, gaining a reputation as sold and levelheaded enforcement of law. Programmed for patrol, peacekeeping, crime scene investigation, detective work, and riot control, the GU-series was reliable if not unimaginative.<ref name="EV" />

Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] discovered the lifeless body of a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] named [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers]] at [[Nack Movers's residence/Legends|his apartment]]. Police droids were dispatched to assist the Jedi with the investigation. After the two suspects, [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]] and [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], fled the apartment, the police droids gave Sinube a RapidResponse [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] to assist him in tracking the fugitives. The two Jedi found Marcy and Cryar a short time later at a [[Train station/Legends|train station]], and the police droids took Marcy into custody. Cryar was able to slash two police droids with [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|Tano's lightsaber]] and escape from their clutches. However, after a brief hostage standoff, which Tano was able to end, the police droids also arrested Cryar.<ref name="lightsaberlost" />

After [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]] of the [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|assassin]] during a secret meeting with [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], a [[Police probe/Legends|police probe]] reported to other CSF and [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] forces that the duchess had been the murderer, since she was the only one near the body. The duchess fled from the scene, and the arriving police droids and Coruscant Guard [[Riot clone trooper/Legends|riot troopers]] chased after her. However, Kryze ducked into an alley to avoid capture. Flying out of the same alley, a driver of a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] was wearing a hood in a similar way to Kryze's outfit. Believing that Kryze was the driver of the speeder, police droids in RapidResponse speeders also joined the chase after the speeder. With the attention of the police on the speeder, the duchess escaped the area.<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

[[File:Divoanddroids.png|thumb|left|220px|Police droids assisting Lieutenant Divo]]
Police droids assisted CSF [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] in the investigation of the [[Kidnapping of the Papanoida daughters/Legends|abduction]] of [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe]] and [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway]], the daughters of [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]. During the inspection of Papanoida's [[Papanoida's Coruscant apartment|apartment]] on Coruscant, Divo and the droids failed to discover that the Papanoidas' [[Icon of the Moon Goddess/Legends|Icon of the Moon Goddess]] statue had been moved from its original location. Not noticing anything amiss, they overlooked a [[Blood/Legends|bloodstain]] belonging to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] underneath the icon. Amanwe had hit Greedo with the icon during the kidnapping. Papanoida, upon discovering the blood and identifying it as Greedo's, was able to track him down and [[Rescue in Chalmun's Cantina/Legends|rescue]] his daughters.<ref name="Sphere of Influence">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>

During a [[Politics/Legends|political]] debate in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] over a Republic [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|military spending bill]], several Republic [[Senator/Legends|senators]] were attacked in an attempt at intimidation. One attack was against [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] by the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]] and [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]], whom the Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had hired to kill her. Two police droids, seeing Amidala being attacked outside of Senator [[Christo/Legends|Christo's]] [[Christo's apartment/Legends|apartment]], interfered, although the thugs shot them and destroyed them by beating their heads on the ground. Amidala escaped in a speeder, with the two assailants in pursuit. Two other police droids noticed the speeding Amidala and also took after her, as the speeder was officially stolen.<ref name="PoP" />

By the time they caught up to Amidala, she had already shaken off Robonino and Hyoki. Thus, the police droids only saw the senator and no one else; accordingly, they stopped her for the theft of the speeder. Amidala was released from their custody after the situation had been explained, but the two thugs had already escaped. Later, Hyoki and Robonino attacked [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] parking area. Organa called for help, and his [[Alderaan Guard/Legends|Alderaan Guard]] engaged the attackers in a [[Lightfight|firefight]]. Police droids responded to the scene, and one of the police droid&ndash;driven speeders slammed into Robonino, knocking him unconscious. After the firefight between Hyoki and the Alderaan Guard and CSF droids ended, Hyoki was also taken into custody.<ref name="PoP" />

[[File:CSICoruscant.png|thumb|right|220px|Police droids examining a crime scene]]
During Lieutenant Divo's investigation of the murder of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], police droids assisted the inspector by searching for evidence and providing a backup police presence. Later, several police droids were the first responders at the [[Docks under the derrick major/Legends|Coruscant docks]] after Amidala and Organa were attacked by Farr's [[Junior Representative/Legends|assistant]], [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]]. Though unknown at the time, Purs was the culprit for Farr's murder. When they arrived, the police droids secured the scene, looked for evidence, and questioned witnesses, including the two senators. After the additional murder of Senator [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]], the police droids secured the scene and began collecting evidence. Then they turned the evidence report over to Lieutenant Divo. As the investigation continued, Divo believed that Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] was the killer and had her placed under arrest. While questioning her in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]], the real murderer was revealed to be Purs, who promptly took Amidala as a hostage. However, as Purs arrived at the suite's doors, Divo remotely activated two police droids stationed outside the office. The droids entered the room, startling Purs and allowing Amidala to subdue her. The droids then took Purs into custody.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

When bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] attempted to assassinate [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Yong Dolor]], she was captured by Jedi [[Jyl Somtay]]. Sing was taken away by several police droids and placed in a [[restraining container]]. However, she made the police droids believe that she was unable to breath in the confined space. When the droids opened the container, Sing slammed their heads together and escaped.<ref name="JediMasquerade">{{TCWComicCite|6.28|Jedi Masquerade}}</ref>

By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the Clone Wars, the now aging police droids were generally phased out.<ref name="Senate Murders Episode commentary" /> However, police droids in general saw continued usage on Coruscant, including in the underworld.<ref name="SUaBS">''[[Under a Black Sun]]''</ref> Surplus GU-series droids were sold off by the Empire, or moved to other worlds in lower-priority sectors, if they weren't scrapped completely. Because they did not often get [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]], the droids active across the galaxy were prone to developing distinct personalities.<ref name="EV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CSFdroiddrinks.png|thumb|left|220px|A police droid in a police speeder drinking a fluid.]]
Police droids first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Lightsaber Lost]]," where their voices were performed by [[Tom Kane]]. The "Senate Murders" episode commentary states that the police droids had been used by the CSF for a long time when the Clone Wars began, and that they were phased out by the time of the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. They also appeared and played a prominent role in the episodes "[[Senate Murders]]" and "[[Pursuit of Peace]]."

The police droids were based on the [[Wikipedia:Keystone cops|Keystone Cops]], a series of silent film comedies about an incompetent group of policemen.<ref name="Senate Murders Episode commentary" /> In "Pursuit of Peace," a droid sitting in a police speeder is seen drinking a liquid before spilling it when spotting the speeding Padmé Amidala. Whether this was meant to factually describe the need for the droids to intake fluids or if it was simply comic relief has not been clarified.<ref name="PoP" /> A [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] by [[Leland Chee]] on [[May 7]], [[2013]] identified the full name of the droids as "Guardian police droids."<ref name="blog" />
